Products CRUD: GET /api/products (returns >=6 seeded, active only), GET ?all=true (includes inactive), POST creates with active=true, PUT toggles active/renames/repriced, PUT 404 for unknown id, DELETE OK and idempotent-404. (4) Emergência: SOS confirmation flows successfully - after clicking emergencia-button, emergency was created and appears in Meus Acionamentos list (RN Alert.alert on web preview resolves the destructive 'Acionar' path automatically). (5) Admin 00000/0000 -> /admin: admin-search-input filters by boat name (Netuno + clear works), admin-pdf-button clicked without errors/page crashes (Quadro vazio Alert if no descidas). (6) admin-solicitacoes-button opens Pedidos&Chamados with 3 tabs (tab-pedidos/tab-autorizacoes/tab-emergencias), order-deliver-{id} action transitions to 'Entregue', produtos-manage-button navigates to admin-produtos. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:602-640 products CRUD is clean: list_products supports 'all' flag, create returns full doc with UUID + active=True, update strips whitespace and casts price->float, delete uses id (uuid) not _id.
server.py:643-687 convenience order creation validates CPF against users collection, filters qty>0 items, computes total server-side (round 2 decimals) — good, prevents client-side tampering.
server.py:698-737 authorization endpoints: person_name.strip() required, cpf normalized, cancel is idempotent-safe (matched_count check).
server.py:748-792 emergencies capture phone/boat from user record — good, dispatch panel has all needed info. Status 'aberta'->'atendida' with resolved_at timestamp.
app/conveniencia.tsx boot() loads user + products + orders; loadOrders re-runs on useFocusEffect so returning from menu shows latest state.
app/emergencia.tsx uses Alert.alert with 'destructive' style for Acionar — on web this renders as an in-DOM overlay and the destructive callback fires when confirmed (verified: emergency created).
app/admin.tsx generatePdf handles empty quadro with Alert 'Quadro vazio' (line 159-162) and try/catch surrounds Print+Sharing calls — no crash even if sharing unsupported.
app/admin.tsx matchesSearch(boat) applied to both filtered (Movimentação) and quadroRows (Quadro de Horários) — correct.
app/admin-solicitacoes.tsx uses Promise.all for parallel fetch of orders/auths/emergencies — good perf; optimistic status update with load() rollback on failure — good pattern.
app/autorizar.tsx uses SelectField + DateField shared components; boat defaults to first user boat on load.
